subject: Recap + custom estimate for CloudFrame — pricing deck attached

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Li <amanda@cloudframe.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + custom estimate for CloudFrame — pricing deck attached

Hi Amanda — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

- Key priorities you called out: predictable latency for customer-facing chat, lower per-token cost for batch embeddings, and private deployment options for regulated accounts.
- Recommended approach: start with Redwood Hosted for a fast MVP (low friction) and reserve Dedicated capacity for the pilot customers that need SLA-backed throughput.
- High-level estimate attached includes (1) hosted usage tier for initial 3 months, (2) optional Dedicated reserve sizing, and (3) a migration path and estimated costs for Private/VPC if you move to that later.

Attachments: CloudFrame_Redwood_Estimate.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/CF-2026-1987

Suggested next steps: quick 20-min walk-through of the estimate and a short technical Q&A with Marissa (she can cover latency/architecture). I have availability Tue/Wed 10–11am PT or Thu 2–4pm PT. Does any of that work for you?

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

--

Thanks — Sergio
